name: nf_publications_columns
description: Per-column analyzer assignments for the nf-publications SearchIndex (syn75081631, source syn16857542). Roles: IDENTIFIER for id-like fields (DOIs, PubMed ids, related-study ids — preserve punctuation, no stemming); nf_scientific_synonyms for free-text scientific/discovery fields (stemming + NF synonym expansion at search time), including the publication title itself; KEYWORD for clean categorical/facet fields (exact match, incl. list-valued facets). The year column falls through to the config defaultAnalyzer (STANDARD); numeric/date fields don't need text analysis. Columns absent from the index are silently skipped at build time.
